description: Lightyear USD cash-fund pool at the ECB rate. mode "opening" (once per pool) replays the statement to as_of (USD cash + ICSUSSDP units at 1.00, from an empty start) and stores the ECB-valued opening checkpoint after approval. The opening books nothing: before approval show the owner the books' USD carrying value (broker account/dimension balance at as_of minus the EUR cash Lightyear shows) next to target_eur and the difference; that one-off difference is shown, not booked, and later revaluations measure from target_eur, so any correction is the owner's separate manual journal. mode "revalue" (default) revalues the pool's USD at the ECB rate of as_of: the replayed USD must equal expected_usd_holding, and the difference to the carrying value is booked on fx_account (default 8500) as journal LY-FX:<account>:USD:<as_of>; zero difference records a journal-free checkpoint. DRY RUN by default; anything unproven is a review, never a plug.

as_of.description: Opening date or reporting date (YYYY-MM-DD, end of day).

broker_account.description: Broker cash account holding the pool (e.g. 1020 / 1120 Lightyear konto)

expected_usd_holding.description: revalue only (required): USD cash + ICSUSSDP value Lightyear shows for as_of.

file_path.description: AccountStatement path/base64 input covering the interval since the last checkpoint (from the account's start for mode=opening). Provide exactly one of file_path or file_ref.

fx_account.description: FX gain/loss account (default: auto-detect 'Kasum/kahjum valuutakursi muutustest', standard 8500).

lightyear_account.description: Lightyear account id (e.g. CHZELUU) when the statement's file name does not carry it.

mode.description: "opening" sets the pool's opening checkpoint once; "revalue" (default) revalues at the reporting date.

plan_handle.description: Execution-plan handle from the reviewed dry run. Required for dry_run=false.

name: book_lightyear_fx_revaluation
title: Revalue Lightyear USD Pool
